drhp.one_liner: Alankit Limited is a Delhi-headquartered provider of e-Governance and citizen-service delivery, serving a retail customer base of over 100 million through a nationwide network of centres and business locations.

Aadhaar Services: Aadhaar enrolment and related services through a network of centres
Ayushman Bharat (PMJAY): Desktop ID card printing technologies (authorised PMJAY Service Agent)
Banking Process Services: Paper-To-Follow (P2F) process support for the Cheque Truncation System at Grid CTS locations
Business Correspondent Services (Kiosk B: Customer Service Points (CSPs) with remote biometric-enabled technology
Digital Signature Certificates: Electronic signature solutions (through subsidiary Verasys Technologies)
GST Compliance Solutions: Platinum Gateway (API gateway management for ASPs)
Cloud-based ERP for Billing and e-Invoicing
Identity and Access Management (Smart ID: ID card printers (national distributor and recognised OEM for IDP)
Insurance: National Insurance Repository (NIR) single-window insurance repository for life and non-life policies
Payment Solutions: Card payment solutions and secure gateway processing
Scanning and Digitization: Recordxpert.com web-based health and wellness records portal

risks.note: One of only two threats the Company explicitly enumerates in the MD&A 'Threats' section. Alankit's e-Governance verticals (PAN, Aadhaar, GST, ID printing, business correspondent) rest on appointments and accreditations that others can also obtain, so new entrants bid directly against its service offerings.
risks.risk: Entry of new competitors into the market, leading to increased competition

risks.note: The second threat explicitly flagged in the MD&A 'Threats' section. Alankit's transaction-linked, citizen-facing services are volume-driven, so a slowdown in consumer spending flows straight through to demand for its services.
risks.risk: Economic fluctuations that may affect consumer spending and overall demand
